text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Sorry... I couldn't win today either.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on it, all I can find are mistakes to learn from.
It really is frustrating...
choice_data_list: Sorry, I couldn't be of any help...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Why are you apologizing, Trainer? The training menu you put together for this race was absolutely perfect.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Failing to win after that is my own fault. I will never blame someone else for my own defeat.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, feeling frustrated
isn't necessarily a bad thing, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: All that pent-up frustration will become the fuel that sets your heart ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm more fired up than ever.
Using this frustration as fuel to move forward, strong and positive.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
On my "Daring Heart"—
I refuse to let things end with me on a losing streak!
choice_data_list: She truly is the Queen of Hearts.
She truly is the Queen of Hearts, isn't she?
Got it. Let's start training again, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
On my "Daring Heart"—
I refuse to let things end with me on a losing streak!
choice_data_list: She truly is the Queen of Hearts.
She truly is the Queen of Hearts, isn't she?
Got it. Let's start training again, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, you say the funniest things!
Well then, next time I'll prove it for sure."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—...That the Queen of Hearts
is the strongest of all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course! No matter how grueling the training,
I will overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And I'll make sure they burn it into their memories.
Our fanatical comeback!
